import json
from cyhole.rugcheck import Rugcheck

# Initialize Rugcheck client
rugcheck = Rugcheck()

# Token mint address (example: USDC on Solana)
token_mint = "EPjFWaLb3odccccccccccccccccccccccccPEKjn"

# Retrieve the full risk report
report = rugcheck.client.get_token_report(mint=token_mint)

# Print the full report
print(json.dumps(report.model_dump() if hasattr(report, 'model_dump') else report.__dict__, indent=2, default=str))
